      (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))

            (if (zero? r) g2
              (let* ((lo (- c r)) (hi (+ c r)))

                        (if (zero? (modulo r 2)) lp (opp lp)))))))))
            grid (range 0 w)))
          g (range 0 h)))))
